sources.author: Harrison Chase
sources.headline: Co-founder & CEO @ LangChain
sources.post_summary: Discussed the rapid evolution of AI agents from simple chatbots to autonomous systems capable of multi-step reasoning and tool use. Highlighted how LangGraph enables developers to build reliable agent workflows with state management and human-in-the-loop capabilities.

sources.author: Sarah Guo
sources.headline: Founder @ Conviction
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on the emerging AI infrastructure stack, comparing current GPU allocation challenges to early cloud computing limitations. Emphasized that companies building specialized inference platforms and agent orchestration layers will capture significant value in the next 18 months.

sources.author: Simon Willison
sources.headline: Independent AI researcher & creator of Datasette
sources.post_summary: Posted about practical automation patterns using LLMs for code generation and data processing workflows. Demonstrated how combining multiple specialized models with proper prompting strategies outperforms single large models for developer tooling tasks.

sources.author: Andrej Karpathy
sources.headline: AI researcher & educator
sources.post_summary: Explored the concept of 'AI employees' - autonomous agents that can handle recurring engineering tasks like code review, testing, and deployment. Stressed the importance of building robust evaluation frameworks before deploying agents in production environments.

sources.author: Alex Hormozi
sources.headline: Founder @ Acquisition.com | Author of $100M Offers
sources.post_summary: Discussed how GTM engineering isn't just about outbound sequences but building systems that compound acquisition efficiency. Shared a framework for mapping buyer journeys to automated touchpoints while maintaining personalization at scale.

sources.author: Elena Verna
sources.headline: Growth Advisor | Ex- Amplitude, SurveyMonkey
sources.post_summary: Explored the intersection of content strategy and revenue operations, arguing that content should be treated as a revenue channel with measurable attribution. Shared data showing how content-led outbound increased pipeline velocity by 34%.

sources.author: Rick Nucci
sources.headline: CEO & Co-founder @ Guru | Ex-Appian
sources.post_summary: Broke down how modern sales ops teams are evolving into GTM engineering functions. Highlighted the shift from manual CRM hygiene to building automated workflows that reduce CAC while increasing win rates.

sources.author: Aakash Gupta
sources.headline: Product Growth Advisor | Newsletter: Product Growth
sources.post_summary: Shared insights on using product-led signals to trigger outbound automation sequences. Explained how his team built a system that identifies high-intent users and routes them to sales with contextual messaging.

sources.author: Sarah Nöckel
sources.headline: Founder @ Fractional RevOps | Ex-HubSpot
sources.post_summary: Detailed a revenue operations overhaul where aligning marketing, sales, and CS data led to a 28% improvement in forecast accuracy. Emphasized building feedback loops between content performance and outbound targeting.

sources.author: Alex Finn
sources.headline: Founder @ VibeCheck | Ex-Google | Shipping solo
sources.post_summary: Shared his 6-week journey building VibeCheck entirely solo after leaving Google. Broke down the tech stack, first 200 users acquired through Twitter threads, and how he handled pricing experiments without a co-founder.

sources.author: Priya Sharma
sources.headline: Software Engineer | Career switch from marketing to dev
sources.post_summary: Detailed her transition from 7 years in marketing to becoming a backend engineer. Highlighted the 10-month self-taught path, key projects that got her interviews, and how she navigated imposter syndrome during her first role.

sources.author: Marcus Chen
sources.headline: Indie Maker | Shipping Side Projects
sources.post_summary: Posted weekly updates on building NotionMail, an email client integrated with Notion. Shared revenue milestones, user feedback loops, and the decision to stay solo instead of raising funding despite inbound interest.

sources.author: Elena Rodriguez
sources.headline: Founder & Engineer @ LoopKit | Previously non-tech
sources.post_summary: Wrote about leaving a stable HR role to build developer tooling. Covered her first failed launch, lessons from talking to 50 developers, and how she validated the idea before writing code.

sources.author: David Kim
sources.headline: Solo Developer | Ex-Finance | Now shipping AI tools
sources.post_summary: Chronicled his pivot from investment banking to building AI productivity tools. Shared how he used his domain knowledge to identify problems, the tech choices for his MVP, and early traction from niche communities.
